events.title: Iran War Escalation

events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation could lead to increased oil prices, benefiting energy stocks, but also potentially destabilizing emerging markets. The US stock market may be resilient due to its strong fundamentals.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $60/barrel or if a peaceful resolution is reached
